interactables.text: The [Gardener], Basil, is trimming the same hedge for the fourth time. 'Animals belong in [Nature]. Cages are cruel. I... I didn't do anything wrong.' His [gloves are caked in fresh mud]. So is the newly planted bulb bed behind him.

keywords.displayText: gloves are caked in fresh mud

interactables.text: Heavy iron [Pruning Shears] left near the fountain. The blade tips are [slightly bent] - the kind of bend you'd get forcing a metal latch.
A stone bird bath near the hedgerow. A few [bright feathers] float on the surface - Rudebeak's distinctive markings. Still crisp, not waterlogged. He was here [this evening].

localDeductionSentence: [Basil the Gardener] won't stop apologizing to the hedge, his [Bent Shears] fit the snapped latch - and the [Evening Feathers] say Rudebeak was loose in this garden tonight.
